loadFailed: Could not read the content folder
cleaned: Tidied up after an interrupted install
noneHint: Install one with the button on the left, or drop an archive here.

sheet.folder: A folder: its files are copied into the content folder.
sheet.replaceHint: The installed version moves to mods/uninstalled.

autoWill.extract: Unpacks it, since it fits on the disk.
autoWill.inplace: Uses the .zip as it is, since it doesn't fit unpacked.

mode.extractHint: Unpacks a copy. Your archive stays where it is.
mode.inplaceHint: The game reads the .zip directly: hardly any extra space.
mode.noSpace: Not enough free space to unpack it.
mode.inplaceZipOnly: Only a .zip can be used in place.

jobs.idleHint: Drop an archive here or use Install mod….

uninstall.label: Uninstall {name}
uninstall.title: Uninstall {name}?
uninstall.body: Nothing is deleted: the mod moves to {folder}. Running games keep using it until they are restarted.

mounted.title: Mounted mods
mounted.hint: Folders and ZIP files here are available to neoOMSI immediately.

plugins.label: Plugins
plugins.hint: Plugins are program code that runs inside the game. Allow them only for mods you trust. Takes effect at the next game start.

order.title: Priority
order.hint: Higher in the list wins: when two entries have the same file, the game uses the one higher up. Drag an entry or use the arrows, then apply.
order.running: Running games keep the order they started with.
order.unreadable: The saved load order could not be read; the default order is in effect
order.forgetHint: Remove it from the load order. If it comes back, it is placed like a new mod.
order.unavailable: Not in the content folder. It keeps its place in case it comes back.
order.newModsHint: Where a new mod goes in the list. Mods already in the list never move by themselves.
order.resetHint: Back to the default order: alphabetical, as before there was a load order.
order.resetBody: Your order is replaced by the default order. Entries that are not installed are dropped.
order.hidden: Fully hidden by {mods}: none of its files are used
order.clash: {mod} uses the folder Vehicles/{folder} for another bus
order.sharedHint: Always last: its files are used only where no mod has them. Plugins in it never load.
